title: Dealer Program Rate Sheet: Acquisition Fees, Participation, Holdbacks and Funding Terms
content:
The Dealer Retail Agreements rate sheet sets, for each Dealer Program tier, the acquisition fee, the flat contract participation, the two holdbacks withheld from funding and the funding turnaround. Every figure is in USD per purchased contract unless stated otherwise.

## Schedule of tier figures

| Dealer Program tier | Acquisition fee deducted from funding | Flat participation paid at funding | Stip holdback withheld | Title holdback withheld | Funding turnaround (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer Program Bronze | 795.00 | 150.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 3 |
| Dealer Program Silver | 745.00 | 200.00 | 750.00 | 500.00 | 3 |
| Dealer Program Gold | 695.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 300.00 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Platinum | 645.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 300.00 | 2 |
| Dealer Program Diamond | 595.00 | 350.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Dealer Program Elite | 495.00 | 400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1 |

Notes to the schedule:

1. **Acquisition fee** — the acquisition fee deducted from the dealer's funding for each purchased contract.
2. **Flat participation** — the flat dealer participation paid at funding for each purchased contract.
3. **Stip holdback** — the amount withheld from funding until post-funding stipulations (proof of income and residence) are cleared.
4. **Title holdback** — the amount withheld from funding until the title naming the company as lienholder is received.
5. **Funding turnaround** — business days from a complete contract package to funding.
6. **Funding method** — for every tier, funds reach the dealer by ACH to the dealer's operating account.
7. **Net funding** — for every tier, the net funding paid to the dealer is: amount financed minus acquisition fee minus holdbacks plus participation.

## Holdback withheld at funding, by tier

The holdback withheld on a funded contract is the stip holdback plus the title holdback taken together:

| Tier | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Diamond | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total withheld | 1500.00 | 1250.00 | 800.00 | 800.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical amount financed)

The amount financed of 20,000.00 below is a hypothetical input chosen for illustration only; the other figures are the schedule's. Net funding is the amount financed less the tier's acquisition fee, less the stip holdback and the title holdback, plus the flat participation.

| Tier | Amount financed | less acquisition fee | less holdbacks | plus participation | Net funding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bronze | 20,000.00 | 795.00 | 1,500.00 | 150.00 | 17,855.00 |
| Silver | 20,000.00 | 745.00 | 1,250.00 | 200.00 | 18,205.00 |
| Gold | 20,000.00 | 695.00 | 800.00 | 250.00 | 18,755.00 |
| Platinum | 20,000.00 | 645.00 | 800.00 | 300.00 | 18,855.00 |
| Diamond | 20,000.00 | 595.00 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 19,505.00 |
| Elite | 20,000.00 | 495.00 | 0.00 | 400.00 | 19,905.00 |

Reading one row in words: on the Dealer Program Gold tier, 20,000.00 less 695.00 is 19,305.00; less the 500.00 stip holdback and the 300.00 title holdback is 18,505.00; plus the 250.00 participation gives a net funding of 18,755.00.
